description: About Mistral Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms. We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited. The Role Mistral is looking for an intern to support AI4Engineering Science in expanding what Mistral's agentic tools can do across the engineering lifecycle, spanning CAE (CAD, CFD, FEA, etc.) and EDA/Semi. Within the team, your core work is helping build the pre- and post-training data for Mistral's LLMs to reason about and execute real engineering tasks. Alongside this, you'll help shape the agent architectures and harnesses that let these models operate reliably inside multi-step engineering workflows, not just answer isolated questions. You'll work closely with domain experts across CAE and EDA to ground this work in how engineers actually work, and with the broader research team to translate that domain grounding into training signal and evaluation benchmarks that measure genuine task competence. This internship is aimed at candidates in the late stages of a Master's degree or a PhD. What You Will Do Help design pretraining, SFT, and RL data for engineering tasks across CAD, CAE, and semiconductor/EDA Help define verifiers and evaluation criteria that capture what "correct" and "high-quality" actually mean for each engineering task, beyond surface-level plausibility Contribute to agent architectures and harnesses: how models plan, call tools, recover from errors, and chain steps together across long-horizon engineering workflows Build evaluation benchmarks and diagnostic tooling to identify where models fail on engineering tasks, and trace those failures back to gaps in data, reward design, or agent scaffolding Collaborate with domain experts across CAE and EDA (and the science and solutions teams more broadly) to identify which engineering workflows are highest-value to target next What We're Looking For Currently completing the final year of a Master's degree or in the late stages of a PhD in AI, machine learning, or an engineering discipline Fluent English with excellent communication skills, able to explain technical ML and engineering concepts to both engineering and non-technical audiences Solid, hands-on machine learning expertise, particularly LLM development (e.g. through research projects, coursework, or open-source work) Some experience running, debugging, or validating real engineering workflows in at least one of CAD, CAE, semiconductor simulation, or EDA You write clean, readable Python code and are comfortable in Linux/HPC environments Self-directed: you don't need detailed roadmaps to make progress Low-ego, collaborative, and eager to learn at the intersection of engineering and ML It would be great if you Have experience building or fine-tuning agentic systems (tool use, multi-step planning, agent orchestration frameworks) Have experience with reward modeling, RLHF/RLAIF/RLVR, or preference-based training Have academic or project experience with CAE or EDA tools (e.g. OpenFOAM, SU2, FreeCAD,OpenCourant, SolidWorks, CATIA, Fluent, Abaqus, LS-DYNA, STAR-CCM+, Cadence/Synopsys/Siemens EDA tools) Have contributed to an open-source or industry codebase Have publications or preprints in engineering and ML venues (NeurIPS, ICLR, JFM, AIAA, etc.) What We Offer You will join a dynamic, collaborative research team working at the frontier of agentic AI for engineering, with direct mentorship from senior AI Scientists, access to frontier models and large-scale compute, and the opportunity to contribute to published research and real products. description: About Mistral Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms. We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited. The Role As an AI Deployment Strategist you will drive the adoption and deployment of Mistral’s AI models, working closely with customers from strategic vision through production implementation. This role sits at the intersection of deep technical expertise, business strategy, and hands-on deployment. Specializing in robotics, you will help customers connect Mistral’s models with robotic systems, operational workflows, and existing technical infrastructure. You will partner with senior executives to design AI roadmaps for robotics, collaborate with Mistral’s technical teams to deliver production solutions, and ensure smooth transitions from pre-sales to post-sales; with a focus on large enterprises. Your job is to understand modern robotics systems well enough, including their capabilities, constraints, and deployment realities and link them to customers hardest challenges and guide them and our technical teams to successful outcomes. Where robotics stands at Mistral today: we focus on delivering the best robotics models on the field, going beyond research to unlock concrete ROI. We work on the intelligence layer only. We integrate with incumbent robot platforms, we do not build robots. We work through research partnerships and pilots with industrial customers, not an off the shelf product. . We customise our models with manufacturers on their own floor via data capture and fine-tuning to reach best scalable results. This role is ideal for those who thrive in a fast paced environment, enjoy solving complex technical challenges in robotics, and are passionate about turning AI science into real world impact. You will be based in Paris, co-located with the science team and our robotics lab, working closely with our Singapore hub, and traveling 30-60%. What You Will Do Strategic discovery and vision setting Lead executive level workshops to identify robotics specific business challenges and opportunities where Mistral’s AI can drive step change improvements for industrial manufacturing. Translate customer priorities into practical robotics use cases across areas such as industrial automation, manipulation, inspection, navigation, and human–robot interaction. Co-create AI adoption roadmaps with customers, articulating the “art of the possible” and a clear path to value. Define a progression from initial experimentation to deployment in real operating environments. Partner with Account Executives to develop business cases, quantify ROI, and align solutions with customer objectives. Help customers prioritize robotics use cases based on value, feasibility, data availability, operational readiness, and deployment risk. AI and robotics solution deployment Architect an end-to-end AI solutions, integrating Mistral’s models and platform into customer manufacturing workflows and technical infrastructure. Determine how these solutions should interact with customers’ robotic systems, software, data pipelines, and operational processes. Partner with the Applied AI and Science teams to design, prototype, and deploy roboticssolutions in production, ensuring scalability and impact. Own pilots and proofs of value, demonstrating the technology’s potential and paving the way for full-scale deployments. Guide deployment at scale on diverse infrastructure (on-premise, edge, cloud) to ensure that proposed solutions account for real world constraints such as latency, reliability, safety, connectivity, hardware limitations, and changing operating conditions. Value realization and customer success Serve as a trusted advisor, guiding customer robotics strategy and ensuring maximum value from Mistral’s solutions. Monitor and communicate outcome-driven KPIs, on both science hypothesis and business impact, with executive sponsors. Identify and address barriers to deployment, including process changes, user adoption, governance, integration ownership, and operational readiness. Proactively identify expansion opportunities within accounts, building on initial wins to drive long-term partnerships. This may include expanding deployments to additional workflows, sites, or robotic platforms. Cross functional collaboration Act as the bridge between customers and Mistral’s Research and Applied AI teams, synthesizing feedback to influence science focused product and research roadmaps. Translate between customer business leaders, robotics specialists, software teams, operational teams, and Mistral’s technical experts. Coordinate multidisciplinary projects involving AI models, robotics software, customer infrastructure, and external technology partners. Create reusable assets, best practices, and playbooks to scale go-to-market efforts and ensure consistent delivery excellence. This includes reference approaches for robotics discovery, piloting, evaluation, and deployment. Contribute to Mistral’s robotics GTM strategy by sharing market insights, customer needs, and deployment learnings. Travel approximately 30 - 60% to foster deep client relationships and support onsite deployment. What We're Looking For 2+ years in a client facing strategic and technical role, for example deployment strategy, solutions architecture, value engineering, technical sales, or applied science, with hands on exposure to robotics or industrial automation. Real depth in robotics, not just an interest. You can talk perception, planning, navigation, manipulation, control, simulation, and human-robot interaction, and you know where vision-language-action models fit and where they don't. You don't need to be a researcher, but you need to be credible with robotics engineers and with our VLA roadmap Strong background in AI science domains (computer vision, robotics, embodied AI, etc.), you hold a degree in a scientific field (e.g., Computer Science, Robotics, Physics, Mathematics) - PhD is a plus. You are aware of recent model architectures in robotics, like VLM/VLA, you are able to understand where they fit. You don't need to be a researcher, but you need to be credible with robotics engineers and with our science roadmap. Deep technical knowledge of AI/ML/Data Science with specialization in science domains, and the credibility to advise highly technical audiences Experience shaping or delivering technology projects in physical or operational environments. Comfortable working with robotics engineers and understanding integration constraints across hardware, software, data, and infrastructure. Strong business acumen and structured problem solving skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into business value Executive presence and strong communication skills with VP and C-level stakeholders on technically advanced solutions. Hands-on experience building and deploying AI applications (Python). Resilient, results-driven, and comfortable leading through influence in a collaborative environment. Comfortable navigating ambiguity and coordinating multidisciplinary teams across business, AI, software, robotics, and operations. Experience with research-to-production transitions and working with research teams is a plus Nice to have Experience deploying robotics, industrial automation, computer vision, or edge-AI solutions. Familiarity with robotics platforms, middleware, or simulation environments such as ROS, Isaac Sim, Gazebo, or equivalent technologies. Exposure to manufacturing, logistics, automotive, aerospace, energy, construction, or other robotics intensive industries. Understanding of robotics data collection, evaluation, simulation, and sim-to-real considerations. A track record taking a robotics or AI application from prototype to production. Experience working with research, engineering, systems-integration, and industrial partner ecosystems. Experience with hardware OEMs, integrators, or industrial procurement on the customer side. Why This Role Matters You will play a pivotal role in shaping how enterprises adopt and deploy AI, ensuring that Mistral’s solutions deliver measurable impact. Robotics is moving from narrowly programmed machines toward more adaptive systems powered by foundation models. Turning that potential into customer outcomes requires more than strong models: it requires clear use-case prioritization, thoughtful integration, realistic deployment plans, and close coordination between business, AI, robotics, and operational teams. You will help customers navigate this transition, translating strategic ambition into production-ready robotics solutions while ensuring that Mistral’s technology addresses real operational needs. Hiring Process • Talent Acquisition screening call • 30min Hiring Manager Interview • 45min Business Acumen Interview • 60min Technical Deep Dive on Physics AI • Panel (Home Prep & Restitution) • 30min Value Talk • Reference check What We Offer We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.
